name: AddConstantColumnNode
label: Add Constant Column
description: Adds a new column populated with a constant value on every row. Useful for labelling, filtering, or adding static metadata columns.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to add the constant column to.

fields.name: NewColumnName
fields.label: New Column Name
fields.description: The name of the new constant column.

fields.name: Value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: The constant value to write into every row of the new column.

fields.name: OverwriteIfExists
fields.label: Overwrite If Exists
fields.description: True to overwrite the column value if the column already exists. Defaults to false.
